<style>
/* Settings · Rules & compliance — flat rows on the page background, keyed on data-rc attributes this module sets */
[data-rc='subnav']{border-bottom:1px solid #ECE8E3}
[data-rc='chip']{height:32px !important;min-height:32px !important;padding:0 12px !important;border-radius:8px !important;border:none !important;box-shadow:none !important;background:transparent !important;color:#3C3C3C !important;font-size:13px !important;font-weight:500 !important;transition:background-color .2s ease,color .2s ease}
[data-rc='chip'],[data-rc='chip'] *{text-decoration:none !important}
[data-rc='chip'] *{color:inherit !important;font-weight:inherit !important;font-size:inherit !important}
[data-rc='chip']:hover{background:#F5EEEA !important}
[data-rc='chip'][data-on='true']{background:#D97757 !important;color:#FFFFFF !important;font-weight:600 !important}
[data-rc='chip']:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #D97757;outline-offset:2px}
[data-rc='col']{max-width:920px}
[data-rc='sechead']{margin-bottom:12px}
[data-rc='applies']{margin-top:4px}
[data-rc='row']{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;border-bottom:1px solid #F0EDE9}
[data-rc='rowl']{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0}
[data-rc='lock']{flex:0 0 auto;white-space:nowrap}
[data-rc='subh']{margin-top:36px}
[data-rc='toolbar']{margin-top:4px}
[data-rc='list']{border-top:1px solid #F0EDE9}
[data-rc='outlist']{border-top:1px solid #F0EDE9;margin-top:8px}
[data-rc='exnote']{margin-top:20px}
[data-rc='dashchip']{flex:0 0 auto;height:32px;padding:0 10px !important;border:1px dashed #DCD6CE;border-radius:8px}
[data-rc='pvline'] p,[data-rc='prewrap'] p,p[data-rc='prewrap']{white-space:pre-wrap}
[data-rc='paused']{margin-top:-4px}
[data-rc='grow2']{flex:2 1 240px !important;min-width:0}
[data-rc='grow1']{flex:1 1 160px !important;min-width:0}
[data-rc='numinp'] input{text-align:right}
[data-rc='ftext'] textarea{resize:none}
[data-rc='seg']{flex:0 0 auto;background:#F2EFEB !important;border-radius:8px;padding:2px !important;gap:2px}
[data-rc='segbtn']{height:28px !important;min-height:28px !important;padding:0 12px !important;border-radius:6px !important;background:transparent !important;border:none !important;box-shadow:none !important;color:#5F5D58 !important;font-weight:500 !important;font-size:13px !important;white-space:nowrap;transition:background-color .2s ease,color .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease}
[data-rc='segbtn'] *{color:inherit !important;font-weight:inherit !important;font-size:inherit !important}
[data-rc='segbtn']:hover{color:#1A1A1A !important}
[data-rc='segbtn'][data-on='true']{background:#FFFFFF !important;color:#1A1A1A !important;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(26,26,26,.12) !important}
[data-rc='segbtn'][data-on='true'][data-tone='block']{color:#8F3F22 !important}
[data-rc='linkbtn'],[data-rc='tlink']{padding:0 !important;height:auto !important;min-height:0 !important;background:transparent !important;border:none !important;box-shadow:none !important;font-size:13px !important;white-space:nowrap}
[data-rc='linkbtn']{color:#6B6862 !important;font-weight:500 !important}
[data-rc='tlink']{color:#B4532F !important;font-weight:600 !important}
[data-rc='linkbtn'] *,[data-rc='tlink'] *{color:inherit !important;font-weight:inherit !important;font-size:inherit !important}
[data-rc='linkbtn']:hover{color:#1A1A1A !important}
[data-rc='tlink']:hover{color:#8F3F22 !important}
[data-rc='rank']{flex:0 0 28px;width:28px !important;height:28px !important;border-radius:50%;display:flex !important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#F2EFEB}
[data-rc='rank'][data-top='yes']{background:#D97757}
[data-rc='rank'] p{text-align:center;line-height:28px}
[data-rc-high='yes'],[data-rc-high='yes'] p{font-weight:600 !important}
[data-rc-dim='true']{opacity:.5}
[data-rc='grip']{cursor:grab;flex:0 0 auto}
[data-rc='lblinp']{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0}
[data-rc='lblinp'] .MuiInput-root{background:transparent !important;border-color:transparent !important;box-shadow:none !important;padding-left:0 !important;border-radius:0 !important;transition:box-shadow .2s ease}
[data-rc='lblinp'] .MuiInput-root:hover{box-shadow:0 1px 0 #DCD6CE !important}
[data-rc='lblinp'] .MuiInput-root:focus-within{box-shadow:0 1px 0 #D97757 !important}

<script>
(function () {
  function scrollMeetingsCalendarToNow() {
    try {
      var el = document.querySelector("[data-block-id='b_xQCuH']");
      if (!el || el.scrollHeight <= el.clientHeight) { return false; }
      var now = new Date();
      var minutesSinceMidnight = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();
      var pxPerMinute = el.scrollHeight / (24 * 60);
      var target = (minutesSinceMidnight * pxPerMinute) - (el.clientHeight / 2);
      var maxScroll = el.scrollHeight - el.clientHeight;
      if (target < 0) { target = 0; }
      if (target > maxScroll) { target = maxScroll; }
      el.scrollTop = target;
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  var tries = 0;
  var timer = window.setInterval(function () {
    tries = tries + 1;
    if (scrollMeetingsCalendarToNow() || tries > 40) {
      window.clearInterval(timer);
    }
  }, 150);

  window.addEventListener('__CLEANUP__', function () {
    window.clearInterval(timer);
  });
})();
</script>

customCode.header:
<script>
/* Create Sequence: hide the SequenceMaker "Exit on" bar (exit conditions live in sequenceDetail Settings > Exit conditions). The bar is drawn inside the custom block's iframe, so a style is added into the canvas iframe: sequenceBlock6 b_EBkkf. Same script as sequenceDetail, without its canvas-fill rules. */
(function () {
  var IDS = ['b_EBkkf'];
  var CSS = '.sm-exit-bar { display: none !important; }';
  function inject(f) {
    try {
      var d = f.contentDocument;
      if (!d || !d.head) return;
      var old = d.getElementById('hide-sm-exit-bar');
      if (old) { if (old.textContent !== CSS) old.textContent = CSS; return; }
      var s = d.createElement('style');
      s.id = 'hide-sm-exit-bar';
      s.textContent = CSS;
      d.head.appendChild(s);
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  function scan() {
    IDS.forEach(function (id) {
      var list = document.querySelectorAll('iframe[data-block-iframe="' + id + '"]');
      for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
        var f = list[i];
        inject(f);
        if (!f.__hideExitBar) {
          f.__hideExitBar = true;
          f.addEventListener('load', function (ev) { inject(ev.target); });
        }
      }
    });
  }
  var queued = false;
  function schedule() {
    if (queued) return;
    queued = true;
    requestAnimationFrame(function () { queued = false; scan(); });
  }
  scan();
  var mo = new MutationObserver(schedule);
  mo.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  window.addEventListener('__CLEANUP__', function () { mo.disconnect(); });
})();
</script>

<style id="time-menu-full-width">
/* Step Time and meeting Start time menus (Form TIME fields): the menu is exactly as wide as its field, never narrower. The width is set by the script below from the field itself. */
.ua-popover[data-time-menu='1'] > div {
  width: var(--time-menu-w) !important;
  min-width: var(--time-menu-w) !important;
  max-width: none !important;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.ua-popover[data-time-menu='1'] li[data-testid='menu-item'] p {
  word-break: normal !important;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.ua-popover[data-time-menu='1'] > div > div {
  /* The menu panel is a flex row, so its option list shrank to the widest label and every option row (and its hover / selected highlight) was only as wide as "12:00 AM". Stretch the list to the panel, so each row spans the menu, keeping the rows own margin, padding and corner radius. */
  flex: 1 1 auto !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  min-width: 0 !important;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.ua-popover[data-time-menu='1'] li[data-testid='menu-item'] {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.ua-popover[data-time-menu='1'] li[data-testid='menu-item'] p {
  /* Option labels used the grey secondary text colour and read as disabled; use the primary text colour, the same as the other dropdowns options (Action Type, Priority). */
  color: var(--text-primary) !important;
}
</style>
<script>
/* The time menu opens in a .ua-popover portal outside the page, so the field's width is copied onto it here: the anchor is the time field the person just clicked or focused. */
(function () {
  var last = null;
  function fieldOf(el) {
    if (!el || !el.closest) return null;
    var box = el.closest('.MuiInput-root');
    if (!box || !box.querySelector('input[type="time"]')) return null;
    return box;
  }
  function remember(ev) {
    var f = fieldOf(ev.target);
    if (f) { last = f; schedule(); }
  }
  function isTimeMenu(p) {
    return !!p.querySelector('li[data-testid="menu-item"][aria-label$=" AM"], li[data-testid="menu-item"][aria-label$=" PM"]');
  }
  function fit() {
    var f = fieldOf(document.activeElement) || last;
    if (!f || !f.isConnected) return;
    var w = f.offsetWidth;
    if (!w) return;
    var list = document.querySelectorAll('.base-Popup-root.ua-popover');
    for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      var p = list[i];
      if (!isTimeMenu(p)) continue;
      if (p.getAttribute('data-time-menu') !== '1') p.setAttribute('data-time-menu', '1');
      var v = w + 'px';
      if (p.style.getPropertyValue('--time-menu-w') !== v) p.style.setProperty('--time-menu-w', v);
    }
  }
  var queued = false;
  function schedule() {
    if (queued) return;
    queued = true;
    requestAnimationFrame(function () { queued = false; fit(); });
  }
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown', remember, true);
  document.addEventListener('focusin', remember, true);
  var mo = new MutationObserver(schedule);
  mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  window.addEventListener('resize', schedule);
  window.addEventListener('__CLEANUP__', function () {
    mo.disconnect();
    document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', remember, true);
    document.removeEventListener('focusin', remember, true);
    window.removeEventListener('resize', schedule);
  });
})();
</script>

@keyframes hpqSweepFull { from { transform: translateX(-100%); } to { transform: translateX(100%); } }

    st.last = now;
    var sk = q('b_3BNtk');

  }

    var now = performance.now();

<script>
/* sequenceDetail: hide the SequenceMaker "Exit on" bar (exit conditions live in Settings > Exit conditions). The bar is drawn inside the custom block's iframe, so a style is added into the two canvases' iframes: sequenceBlock7 b_ZQHjz (view) and sequenceBlock6 b_EBkkf (edit). The same style makes the warm dotted canvas background fill the whole iframe height. */
(function () {
  var IDS = ['b_ZQHjz', 'b_EBkkf'];
  var CSS = '.sm-exit-bar { display: none !important; }'
    + ' html, body { height: 100%; }'
    + ' html { background-color: rgb(253, 252, 251); background-image: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.055) 1px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 1px); background-size: 14px 14px; }'
    + ' #ua-custom-block, .sm-page, .sm-canvas { min-height: 100% !important; }';
  function inject(f) {
    try {
      var d = f.contentDocument;
      if (!d || !d.head) return;
      var old = d.getElementById('hide-sm-exit-bar');
      if (old) { if (old.textContent !== CSS) old.textContent = CSS; return; }
      var s = d.createElement('style');
      s.id = 'hide-sm-exit-bar';
      s.textContent = CSS;
      d.head.appendChild(s);
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  function scan() {
    IDS.forEach(function (id) {
      var list = document.querySelectorAll('iframe[data-block-iframe="' + id + '"]');
      for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
        var f = list[i];
        inject(f);
        if (!f.__hideExitBar) {
          f.__hideExitBar = true;
          f.addEventListener('load', function (ev) { inject(ev.target); });
        }
      }
    });
  }
  var queued = false;
  function schedule() {
    if (queued) return;
    queued = true;
    requestAnimationFrame(function () { queued = false; scan(); });
  }
  scan();
  var mo = new MutationObserver(schedule);
  mo.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  window.addEventListener('__CLEANUP__', function () { mo.disconnect(); });
})();
</script>

  /* The menu panel is a flex row, so its option list shrank to the widest label and every option row (and its hover / selected highlight) was only as wide as "12:00 AM". Stretch the list to the panel, so each row spans the menu, keeping the rows own margin, padding and corner radius. */
  flex: 1 1 auto !important;

}

}
</style>
<script>
/* The time menu opens in a .ua-popover portal outside the page, so the field's width is copied onto it here: the anchor is the time field the person just clicked or focused. */
(function () {
  var last = null;
  function fieldOf(el) {
    if (!el || !el.closest) return null;
    var box = el.closest('.MuiInput-root');
    if (!box || !box.querySelector('input[type="time"]')) return null;
    return box;
  }
  function remember(ev) {
    var f = fieldOf(ev.target);
    if (f) { last = f; schedule(); }
  }
  function isTimeMenu(p) {
    return !!p.querySelector('li[data-testid="menu-item"][aria-label$=" AM"], li[data-testid="menu-item"][aria-label$=" PM"]');
  }
  function fit() {
    var f = fieldOf(document.activeElement) || last;
    if (!f || !f.isConnected) return;
    var w = f.offsetWidth;
    if (!w) return;
    var list = document.querySelectorAll('.base-Popup-root.ua-popover');
    for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      var p = list[i];
      if (!isTimeMenu(p)) continue;
      if (p.getAttribute('data-time-menu') !== '1') p.setAttribute('data-time-menu', '1');
      var v = w + 'px';
      if (p.style.getPropertyValue('--time-menu-w') !== v) p.style.setProperty('--time-menu-w', v);
    }
  }
  var queued = false;
  function schedule() {
    if (queued) return;
    queued = true;
    requestAnimationFrame(function () { queued = false; fit(); });
  }
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown', remember, true);
  document.addEventListener('focusin', remember, true);
  var mo = new MutationObserver(schedule);
  mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  window.addEventListener('resize', schedule);
  window.addEventListener('__CLEANUP__', function () {
    mo.disconnect();
    document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', remember, true);
    document.removeEventListener('focusin', remember, true);
    window.removeEventListener('resize', schedule);
  });
})();
</script>

/* Tablet-width responsive fix (1024-1439px): the platform's page-frame wrapper ([data-name='canvas']) forces a hard 1440px min-width for this desktop-base page, clipping the right column with no scrollbar affordance below 1440px. Relax that floor and narrow the right column proportionally in the tablet band so the grid actually resizes instead of clipping. The canvas rule uses :has() to only ever apply while THIS page (by data-page-id) is the one open inside it, since canvas itself sits above this page's own DOM scope. Left untouched at >=1440px, matching the confirmed-correct desktop layout. */
@media (min-width: 1024px) and (max-width: 1439px) {
  [data-name='canvas']:has([data-page-id='e_6a4cca1b2dae9d196020c5db']) {
    min-width: 0 !important;
    width: 100% !important;

    min-width: 0 !important;

}

<style>
/* Shared table filter popovers (Opportunities list + Opportunity Detail, same rules on both pages).
   The popovers render in a portal outside the page scope, so a block's own custom CSS cannot reach them.
   1. Field-chip popover (Stage, Owner, Health, Type, Lead source, Persona ...): a "<Field> <operator>" header row
      followed by one value row. It hugs its content between 208px and 264px; long option labels truncate. */
.ua-popover > .interface-theme:has(> .flex.flex-col.p-sm > .flex.items-center.gap-xs.px-md + .flex.flex-col.pt-xs) {
  width: max-content !important;
  min-width: 208px !important;
  max-width: 264px !important;
}
.ua-popover > .interface-theme > .flex.flex-col.p-sm:has(> .flex.items-center.gap-xs.px-md + .flex.flex-col.pt-xs) {
  width: 100% !important;
  min-width: 0 !important;
  padding: 6px !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
}

  width: 100% !important;

}
.ua-popover > .interface-theme > .flex.flex-col.p-sm > .flex.items-center.gap-xs.px-md + .flex.flex-col.pt-xs > .MuiList-root {
  width: auto !important;
  min-width: 0 !important;
}

}
